fixes.change: Registered a NEW signal sig.fetch_execute.v1 covering command substitution, process substitution, eval substitution and backticks. sig.piped_installer.v2 left untouched — spec/signals.md forbids mutating a registered version.
fixes.proof: Imported the live module and called signals(). The official Homebrew command now yields sig.fetch_execute.v1; so do sh -c "$(curl)", bash <(curl), eval "$(curl)", python3 -c "$(curl)", source <(curl), zsh+wget, node -e, backticks. 10/10 designed positives caught.
fixes.false_positives: 0 on 10 negatives: pipe-to-jq, download-only, echo substitution, capture-to-variable, interpreter-without-fetch, process-substitution-without-fetch, local python -c, git clone, wget archive, prose.
fixes.use_mention_preserved: The warned form ('Never run bash -c "$(curl ...)"') is still suppressed by the existing discriminator — verified through the live module, not by reading.

fixes.change: calibrate() recorded non-allowlisted candidates nowhere. They are now abstentions with reason 'not_in_production_allowlist'. Schema gained that enum value; no new top-level field, because the assertion schema is additionalProperties:false and an abstention is precisely 'we had a candidate and did not assert it, here is why'.
fixes.proof: Adversarial probe: HP@0.72 (above its 0.65 floor) and MT@0.99 are NOT asserted and ARE recorded. Nothing dropped without a record. PII_REDACTED correctly appears in neither — it is asserted upstream by the redaction step.
fixes.test_change: test_gateway_rejects_nonproduction_even_at_full_confidence asserted ==([],[]), whose second [] encoded the silent drop as intended behaviour. Rewritten STRICTLY STRONGER: still requires that nothing asserts, and now additionally requires that every withheld code leaves an auditable record with the right reason, and that PII_REDACTED is in neither list.

fixes.proof: Injected the adapter into the live chatgpt.com page and compared SHA-256 of the injected source against the file on disk: 57a9ff3be7143307 == 57a9ff3be7143307, so the live test exercised the real file bytes. Result: anchor '[data-markdown-text-style="assistant-message"]' matched, 1 response found, stable id fc17162b-298b-4198-ac4a-6805dc5ddaaf extracted, response text read including the Homebrew command, streaming correctly false.
fixes.legacy_selector_measurement: [data-message-author-role] -> 0 nodes total and 0 assistant on live chatgpt.com. Re-verified by building the attribute name dynamically, because the browser tool redacts that literal key and an earlier reading could have been a redaction artifact rather than a real zero.
design_notes: Ordered anchors: a vendor rename should degrade coverage, not zero it.
responseId() returns null when the page offers no stable id — the caller must then refuse rather than fall back to DOM position. That is the foundation F-088 needs.
Zero anchors matched renders UNSUPPORTED. Guessing an anchor is how a tag lands on the wrong text.
